annotations.title: Get the download link for an exported backup

description: Returns a signed link, valid for 6 hours, to download a backup exported with startBackupExport. Fails if the export is not ready yet; requires a paid account. Returns url (a .tar.gz for the user) and expiresAt.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
